name: navbar-mega
title: Navbar Mega Menu
description: Top bar with full-width mega-menu panels and its own focus management: arrow keys, Escape and click-away all behave.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; href?: string; sections?: { title: string; links: { label: string; href: string; description?: string }[] }[]; featured?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Top-level entries. Entries with sections become menu buttons that open a panel.

props.name: action
props.description: Call to action at the end.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the nav landmark.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Open panels on mouse hover as well as on click.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the panel takes to fade in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
